$description: Closed assetRole vocabulary. Every media field in a PageSpec names exactly one role; each role carries an AI-generation policy that verify_all.py pins per role (a different-but-valid policy value is a failure, not just a non-member).
licensing: Siena (siena.cx) is a REAL, live company. This design-repo and the clone it describes are for LOCAL REFERENCE ONLY. Do not deploy the clone publicly, do not publish this repository, and do not ship generated pages that reuse Siena's brand, people or customers outside Siena itself.

Feature Deck (Web Light/Italic/Regular/Condensed) and Tiempos Text are commercially licensed fonts licensed to Siena; Font Awesome 6 Sharp/Pro are licensed icon fonts. Their woff2 files in the clone are not licensed for redistribution.
All customer, partner, investor and integration logos are third-party trademarks.
People photos and names belong to real people; testimonial quotes are attributed statements. A generator must never invent a quote and attribute it to a real person.

A generated page (PageSpec mode `generated`) is a different brand: it must not contain Siena's name, wordmark, glyph, URLs, marketing copy, screenshots or media, or any real customer, testimonial author, founder, team member or case-study identity (assets/asset-roles.json sourceBrand).
globalRules: AI generation must never reproduce, redraw or approximate Siena's logos or any real customer/partner logo.
AI generation must never create photos or likenesses of real people (founders, employees, customers).
Long-form proprietary prose (legal text, interview transcripts, founders letter, team bios) is placeholder in the clone and must not be generated as if it were real.
assetRef values are clone-relative paths (assets/, svg/, lottie/, video/) resolved against the clone's public/ folder; no asset files are shipped in this repo.
In `mode: generated`, a slot never falls back to a source asset: use the role's generationSafeSubstitutes (placeholder or user-supplied) or omit the slot.

Fictional people and customers in generated pages carry invented names that match no entry of sourceBrand, avatar.placeholder (never a photographic likeness) and original quotes (`source: generated`).

animation.generated.description: Original generated animation for the generated page's own brand.
animation.generated.guidance: Generate fresh motion graphics; never reuse or re-skin the source's animation files.
animation.generated.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: usable in `mode: generated` PageSpecs in the sections that list it in `generatedAssetRoles`. Generate fresh motion graphics; never reuse or re-skin the source's animation files.

animation.lottie.generatedModeGuidance: Siena's own feature-card animations (embedded imagery). A generated page uses an original animation generated for its own brand.

avatar.placeholder.description: Neutral silhouette or initials avatar for a fictional person.
avatar.placeholder.guidance: Never a photographic likeness, real or synthetic-looking. Initials or a flat silhouette only.
avatar.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: usable in `mode: generated` PageSpecs in the sections that list it in `generatedAssetRoles`. Never a photographic likeness, real or synthetic-looking. Initials or a flat silhouette only.

badge.compliance.guidance: A real certification mark: reuse exact; never invent certifications or badges.
badge.compliance.generatedModeGuidance: A real third-party certification mark. A generated page must never show a compliance or certification badge it has not earned: omit the slot (no substitute exists).

brand.siena-glyph.description: Siena 'S' glyph/badge used as the agent avatar in chat mocks.
brand.siena-glyph.guidance: Reuse exact. Never generate a new brand glyph.
brand.siena-glyph.generatedModeGuidance: Siena's own 'S' glyph. A generated page carries its own placeholder or user-supplied brand glyph, never this one or a lookalike.

brand.siena-wordmark.description: Siena 'siena' wordmark SVG (nav, footer, lead header, AI Lab nav, co-brand lockups).
brand.siena-wordmark.guidance: Reuse the clone's exact local file. Never redraw, recolour, re-letter or invent a Siena mark.
brand.siena-wordmark.generatedModeGuidance: Siena's own wordmark. A generated page carries its own placeholder or user-supplied wordmark, never this one or a lookalike.

embed.youtube.description: YouTube iframe on conversation detail pages: the ONLY deliberate external request in the clone.
embed.youtube.guidance: Only www.youtube.com/embed/<11-char id> with autoplay=0; only inside media.video-embed; never add other third-party embeds, trackers or form endpoints.
embed.youtube.generatedModeGuidance: A real YouTube video of Siena's conversations. A generated page uses a user-supplied video file; it never embeds the source's video id or any third-party embed.

icon.generated.description: Original or openly licensed icon chosen for the generated page.
icon.generated.guidance: Not a Font Awesome Pro/Sharp codepoint of the source's licensed font; use an original or openly licensed icon set.
icon.generated.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: usable in `mode: generated` PageSpecs in the sections that list it in `generatedAssetRoles`. Not a Font Awesome Pro/Sharp codepoint of the source's licensed font; use an original or openly licensed icon set.

icon.glyph.description: Font Awesome 6 Sharp Light/Brands glyphs by codepoint (licensed icon fonts).
icon.glyph.guidance: Use the licensed font files the clone already ships; do not substitute brand marks.
icon.glyph.generatedModeGuidance: Font Awesome Pro/Sharp glyphs are third-party licensed to Siena. A generated page uses an original or openly licensed icon chosen for it, never these codepoints.

illustration.abstract-glow.generatedModeGuidance: Abstract blurred gradients carry no brand, person or product. A generated page may use them (a new gradient is generated, never the source's file).

illustration.editorial.generatedModeGuidance: Siena's commissioned editorial hero imagery. A generated page uses an original generated illustration or a user-supplied image.

illustration.generated.description: Original generated illustration, texture or scene made for the generated page's own brand.
illustration.generated.guidance: Generate fresh artwork. It must not trace or approximate any file observed on the source.
illustration.generated.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: usable in `mode: generated` PageSpecs in the sections that list it in `generatedAssetRoles`. Generate fresh artwork. It must not trace or approximate any file observed on the source.

illustration.swash.generatedModeGuidance: Siena's hand-drawn swash underline artwork. A generated page draws its own.

image.card-background.guidance: Reuse exact; several contain blurred real people.

logo.customer.generatedModeGuidance: Real customer trademarks. A generated page shows only placeholder logos of fictional companies or logos the user supplies for their own customers; it never shows, redraws or approximates any company observed on the source.

logo.integration.generatedModeGuidance: Real third-party product logos shown as integrations. A generated page uses placeholder logos or logos the user supplies.

logo.partner-investor.guidance: Real trademarks: reuse exact files, never generate or imply new partnerships/investors.
logo.partner-investor.generatedModeGuidance: Real investor / partner trademarks. A generated page uses placeholder logos or logos the user supplies.

photo.editorial-scene.generatedModeGuidance: Siena's proprietary editorial photography (real people, products, offices). A generated page uses an original generated scene or a user-supplied photo.

availabilityNote.reference-only: The source's own brand, artwork, screenshots, media and live endpoints. Available only in `mode: reference` PageSpecs; a generated page must use one of the listed generationSafeSubstitutes.
availabilityNote.generation-safe: Carries no source identity or third-party identity. Available in both modes (in generated mode only in the sections that list it in `generatedAssetRoles`).
availabilityNote.blocked-for-generation: Third-party identity or licensed material (real customers, partners, investors, real people, certification marks, licensed fonts/icons). Never available in a generated page in any form; the slot is filled by a listed fictional/user-supplied substitute role or, when none is listed, omitted.

modes.reference: A clone or fidelity-validation page for the SOURCE brand (Siena). Every role is available, as before.
modes.generated: A new page for ANY OTHER brand. Only generation-safe roles; only the roles each section lists in `generatedAssetRoles`; assetRef under placeholder/, generated/ or user-supplied/; hrefs only internal or reserved .example/.invalid hosts; no text, label, alt text, route, id or href may carry the source brand, source URLs, source customers or people, or source marketing copy (`sourceBrand`); testimonial quotes and copy are `generated` provenance and may not reproduce a verified quote.

sourceBrand.$comment: GENERATED by extraction/build_source_brand.py from the clone's src/, specs and public/ folders. Not human-reviewed. Do not hand-edit; re-run the script.
sourceBrand.note: Matched case-insensitively against every human-readable string of a `mode: generated` PageSpec (page id, route, head, headings, body, labels, items, alt text, hrefs). Structural vocabulary (template and section ids, variant names, enum values) is exempt: it is the contract's own vocabulary, not rendered text.

brand.derivation: 'siena' is the only brand token found in src/ (case-insensitively, as a substring: Siena, siena.cx, sienaai, siena_ai, Ask Siena, SienaLogo ...). 'idiomatic' is the host the Insights page links to for login (src/components/content/InsightsPage.jsx).

urls.note: Any other http(s) URL in a generated page's free text is GENERATED_MODE_EXTERNAL_URL; PageSpec href fields are restricted by the schema to internal paths or reserved .example/.invalid hosts.

customers.ambiguousNote: Single-word names that are English words (checked against the system word list when the registry is built) fall in three tiers: ALL-CAPS 4+ letters are matched like any name; rare words are matched only in the source's own capitalisation ((?-i:...) patterns); words the source's own copy also uses in lower case, and lower-case styled brand names, are listed here and NOT matched in text (a generated page legitimately says 'create' or 'hero'). They are still blocked as logos (assetRole) and as asset files.
customers.derivation: logo owners: hero ticker names, `alt` of the investor / partner / lead-page logo arrays, `logoAlt`, `brand`, `company`, 'at X' / ', X' tails of testimonial roles, conversation `guest` brands, customer-story slug stems that also occur in the story title.

people.derivation: multi-word capitalised `name:` values (testimonial authors, conversation guests, founders / team, partner testimonial subjects, wall-of-love and quote-grid people) and `guest:` names; first names alone are not matched.

thirdPartyPlatforms.note: Integration and competitor products the source names. They are real companies but not the source's customers; a generated page may legitimately mention them, so a match only warns.

copy.note: A text field is rejected when any run of 5 consecutive normalised words (lower-case, punctuation stripped) hashes to a source shingle. Source strings shorter than 5 words (labels, 'Book a demo', short headings) are not checked: they are too generic to attribute.

assets.note: assetRef values of a generated page must be under placeholder/, generated/ or user-supplied/ (schema), and the file stem must not equal a stem of any file in the clone's public/, recon/ or mirrored *_files folders (stored as hashes).
